zotero.abstractNote: The collaborative ﬁltering (CF) approach to recommenders has recently enjoyed much interest and progress. The fact that it played a central role within the recently completed Netﬂix competition has contributed to its popularity. This chapter surveys the recent progress in the ﬁeld. Matrix factorization techniques, which became a ﬁrst choice for implementing CF, are described together with recent innovations. We also describe several extensions that bring competitive accuracy into neighborhood methods, which used to dominate the ﬁeld. The chapter demonstrates how to utilize temporal models and implicit feedback to extend models accuracy. In passing, we include detailed descriptions of some the central methods developed for tackling the challenge of the Netﬂix Prize competition.
